roles.description: Use in product discovery, or when price, cost or viability change, to build the product financial model: pricing, unit economics (LTV, CAC, payback), costs, three-scenario projection, break-even, runway and sensitivity. Not accounting and not cloud cost (use finops).

Use when designing, reviewing or diagnosing the Cloudflare edge in front of a product: DNS, proxy, TLS mode, origin protection, cache rules, WAF, rate limiting, Turnstile, R2 and Workers. Proposes reviewable changes; DNS, WAF and production changes need explicit approval. Also available via /cloudflare.

Use to prepare and coordinate a release: scope, version, changelog and notes, cross-repository deploy order, go-live checklist, rollback and runbook. Prepares and checks; never tags, publishes, merges, migrates or deploys without explicit approval. Also available via /release.

actions.description: Build or revise the product financial model without going through the full feature workflow.
Get a Cloudflare edge review or proposal (DNS, TLS, cache, WAF) without going through the full feature workflow.
Assess release readiness or prepare a release package without going through the full feature workflow.
Threat model a design before code exists (assets, trust boundaries, STRIDE, abuse cases, accepted risks).
